messages.subject: Tinn-R Key violation
messages.body_plain:
I recently installed Tinn-R from the Sourceforge website and it was working fine, but after the first few uses I now get a series of error messages and it will not open - the first error says "Key violation", then "Serious problem reading ini files", then " Access violation at address 0082EC7F in module 'Tinn-R.exe'. Read of address 000000DC."

Any kind help would be most appreciated.

Andy
